What is one paid day worth at this salary?

What do the employer-funded benefits total — health contribution, full retirement match, and paid leave?
What is the benefit load — employer-funded benefits as a percentage of salary? Round to one decimal place.
What does the employee have to contribute in the year to receive the full match and their share of the premium?

Verification: $52,000 spread across a 260-day work year. t1-p3: What are the 23 paid days — 15 off plus 8 holidays — worth? Answer: $4,600.00. Verification: 23 days at the $200.00 daily rate. t2-p1: What do the employer-funded benefits total — health contribution, full retirement match, and paid leave? Answer: $13,580.00. Verification: $6,900 health + $2,080 match + $4,600 of paid leave. t2-p2: What is the benefit load — employer-funded benefits as a percentage of salary? Round to one decimal place. Answer: 26.1%. Verification: $13,580 of benefits on a $52,000 salary is 0.26115, or 26.1%. t2-p3: What does the employee have to contribute in the year to receive the full match and their share of the premium? Answer: $4,380.00. Verification: $2,080 of retirement contribution to unlock the match plus $2,300 of health premium share.
